analysis.reference_mask: Use saved mask_away_from_transitions, require exact complement of near_open OR near_close; all legal source-support t>=1, all demos0..29.
analysis.primary_reference: For each task/arm/seed mean translation MSE on all fixed reference frames; no selection by predictions, errors, outcomes or phase results.
analysis.secondary_reference: Same fixed mask additionally conditioned on the expert gripper sign of the contrasted frame; zero-reference class gives null, no fallback.
analysis.centering: r_seed_frame = translation_MSE_seed_frame - reference_mean_seed; negative residuals retained, no clipping, division or rescaling.
analysis.fixed_contrasts: Reuse all192 prior cross-seed groups and their exact expert frame IDs and error/correct seed sets. Check against cached strict signs and fixed phase/context definitions; no new filtering.
analysis.identity: centered_difference = raw_difference - (mean(reference_wrong_seeds)-mean(reference_correct_seeds)); check direct residual difference abs1e-12.
analysis.same_seed_identity: Subtracting a seed-specific constant cancels in wrong-minus-correct comparisons within that seed and same expert command; do not report it as new independent evidence.
analysis.primary_groups: open/post/expert_open_pred_close/all for both tasks/all3 arms; preserve pre/at/close/opposite direction/boundary and no-opposite-overlap controls.
analysis.summaries: Per-frame raw/reference-gap/centered values, count/mean/median/min/max/positive counts; per-demo summaries with missing demos; equal-demo mean/median secondary. No task pooling.
analysis.interpretation_rule: Positive adjusted mean means the chosen additive nontransition reference does not remove the conditional association; it does not rule out all global-fit confounding or establish phase-specific causality.
analysis.flags: Report raw_positive_mean, centered_positive_mean and mean-sign reversal separately, null when no valid adjusted contrasts. No statistical significance, training gate, causal explained-fraction or checkpoint choice.
analysis.empty_and_missing: Keep every original frame record and group; null for missing references/empty contrasts, retain n/missing; never impute0 or alter seed sets.
analysis.preservation: Original phase outputs, predictions, targets, masks and all checkpoint/data files unchanged.
analysis.training_decision: Keep500/stabilization5/current loss unless a separately frozen controlled diagnostic supports a specific modification.

failure_rule: Abort on hash/source-role/matrix/reference-mask/count/frame-ID/seed-set/phase membership/nonfinite/bounds/identity mismatch; preserve old outputs, never relax gates.
